name: BUZZ or DIE
source:
The rules are simple. Dive into your opponent's mindscape and search for secrets. Turn those secrets into content and make a short video. Gain the most Likes from the audience to win.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2899240/BUZZ_or_DIE/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
规则非常简单：潜入对手的精神世界搜寻秘密，将那些秘密加工成素材制作成短视频——在观众手中斩获最多点赞的人即可获胜。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2899240/BUZZ_or_DIE/]Steam[/url]]
